title: 第七章对战王府高手第八章紫电狂狮
content_zh:
“好了，还是赶紧忙正事吧。这次家主让我们来寻找那头伤人的妖兽，好将其击毙，笼络叶北城人心。”
“连城主府都解决不了的事情，若是被我们解决了。我们王府的名誉一定会再度水涨船高。”王府之人，一位络腮胡大汉说道。
苏阳并未急着出手，而是在隐蔽的树上打量着王府几人的实力。
“一位三玄境，四位真武境九品。这王家倒是下了血本啊。”苏阳能够感觉到，五人之中，只有那个络腮胡大汉，有着三玄境的修为，其余四人都不足为惧。
自己动手的话，倒不是没有机会将他们全部拿下。
顺便，也让王家知晓，别忘了，还有我苏阳的存在。
想到这里，苏阳不由紧握了手中的木棍，体内的至尊之血也开始缓缓流动，沸腾。
“小子，这还是三个月以来，你第一次与真正的修炼者作战吧？也正好让你练练手，妖兽虽然能够让你提升战斗力，可毕竟只是畜生，修炼者可就不一样了。你应该也知道，人类的狡诈可是天性。”
“也让本大圣看看，你这三个月的苦修，究竟能否让我满意吧。”
脑海里再度响起了大圣的声音，苏阳闻言，嘴角上扬，一股自信涌上心头道：“前辈且看好了，我苏阳绝对不会让您失望的。”
说罢，苏阳便如同猎豹一般，朝着自己的猎物，缓缓而去。
五位王家高手，此刻刚欲准备离开小溪旁边，继续去寻找那头伤人的妖兽。刚一转身，便看见一位手持木棍的少年，正盯着自己等人。
“各位，来都来了，就别着急走吧？”苏阳看着五人笑道。
五位王家高手见状，都不由一愣。谁曾想想到，居然在这妖兽山脉力量，会冒出来一个毛头小子？
“哪里来的娃娃？不知道我们是何人吗？”五人之中，一位矮个子指着苏阳囔囔道。
而络腮胡大汉则是要沉稳的多，作为三玄境高手，感知力肯定是五人之中最强的，可是，眼前这小子的出现，他却不曾有半点感应，足以证明，此子不是普通人。
而且，络腮胡大汉总觉得眼前的小子，似乎有点眼熟。
但却一时半会又想不起来，到底在哪里见过？
“知道，不就是王家王府的走狗吗？”苏阳语气冰冷，面露杀机道。
“小子，你找死！”矮个子闻言，当时就怒了，看似瘦小的身躯，居然如同野兽一般，瞬间朝苏阳扑了过去。

苏阳见状，纹丝不动。
肉体对碰？哼！
只听见轰的一声，那矮个子高手瞬间倒飞而出，出拳的右手，此刻已经全部碎裂，鲜血淋漓。
“啊~~！！！”
“我的手！！！”矮个子倒地哀嚎，打滚道。
其余四人见状，都不由一愣。齐刷刷将目光落在了此刻一脸讥笑，毫发无损的苏阳身上，他们心中清楚，这矮个子好歹也是真武境圆满的高手，放在整个叶北城，也足以令人畏惧。
然而，眼前这少年，都还没出手，居然就让矮个子瞬间受了重创？
这究竟是怎么回事？
“说你是狗，你还不信？我这就送你上西天！”苏阳无视其余四人，只盯着躺在地上的矮个子道。
随即金光一闪，一道残影从王府四位高手眼前划过。
content_en:
"Okay, let's get down to business. This time the head of the family asked us to find the hurtful monster so that we can kill it and win over Ye Beicheng's hearts."
"If even the City Lord's Palace cannot solve the problem, if it is solved by us, the reputation of our Palace will definitely rise again." said a man from the Palace, a bearded man.
Su Yang was not in a hurry to take action, but looked at the strength of the people in the palace from a hidden tree.
"One is at the Three Mysterious Realm, and four are at the ninth level of the True Martial Realm. This Wang family has invested a lot of money." Su Yang could feel that among the five people, only the bearded man had the cultivation of the Three Mysterious Realm, and the other four were not afraid.
If you do it yourself, it's not like you have no chance of capturing them all.
By the way, let the Wang family know that I, Su Yang, also exist.
Thinking of this, Su Yang couldn't help but clenched the wooden stick in his hand, and the supreme blood in his body began to flow slowly and boil.
"Boy, this is your first time fighting a real cultivator in three months, right? It's also a good opportunity for you to practice your skills. Although monsters can improve your combat effectiveness, they are just beasts after all, and cultivators are different. You should also know that human beings are cunning by nature."
"Let this great sage see if your three months of hard training can satisfy me."
The voice of the Great Sage sounded in his mind again. When Su Yang heard this, the corners of his mouth raised, and a surge of confidence came into his heart: "Senior, be careful, I, Su Yang, will never let you down."
After saying that, Su Yang walked slowly towards his prey like a cheetah.
The five masters of the Wang family were about to leave the creek and continue looking for the hurtful monster. As soon as he turned around, he saw a young man holding a wooden stick, staring at him and others.
"Everyone, you're here, why don't you leave in a hurry?" Su Yang looked at the five people and said with a smile.
When the five Wang family masters saw this, they couldn't help but be stunned. Who would have thought that a young boy would appear in this monster mountain range?
"Where did the doll come from? Don't you know who we are?" Among the five, a short man pointed at Su Yang and muttered.
The bearded man was much calmer. As a master of the Three Mysterious Realms, his perception must be the strongest among the five. However, he did not feel the slightest bit when the boy appeared in front of him, which proved that this boy was not an ordinary person.
Moreover, the bearded man always felt that the boy in front of him seemed a bit familiar.
But I couldn't remember it for a while. Where did I see it?
"I know, isn't he just a lackey of the Wang Family and the Royal Palace?" Su Yang said with a cold tone and murderous intent on his face.
"Boy, you are looking for death!" The short man became angry when he heard this. His seemingly thin body turned out to be like a wild beast, and he instantly rushed towards Su Yang.
When Su Yang saw this, he remained motionless.
Physical confrontation? snort!
There was only a bang, and the short master flew backwards instantly. The right hand that punched was completely shattered and dripping with blood.
"Ah~~!!!"
"My hand!!!" The short man fell to the ground and whined, rolling.
The other four people couldn't help but be stunned when they saw this. They all turned their gazes on Su Yang, who was still unscathed with a sneer on his face. They knew in their hearts that this short man was a master of the True Martial Realm, and he was enough to be feared in the entire Ye Beicheng.
However, before the young man in front of him even made a move, he actually caused the short man to be severely injured in an instant?
What is going on?
"You are said to be a dog, don't you believe it? I will send you to the West right now!" Su Yang ignored the other four people and only stared at the short man lying on the ground.
Then there was a flash of golden light, and an afterimage flashed past the eyes of the four masters of the palace.
